scope: Actual motor torque and contact with two temporary collider walls on the installed site; API pedal holds/taps/reverse and runtime timescale pause. Roughly 14 game seconds, max 0.65m displacement. No keyboard synthesis, player walking, full route or comfort claim.

checks.name: held throttle at front wall activates once
wall pedal taps do not rearm
checks.detail: 0.1s pressed/released API pulses; additional activations=0; actual displacement rearm=False. A stationary car requires continuous pedal release for the full cooldown. These are not synthesized keyboard events.

checks.name: released pedal rearms reverse departure
checks.detail: Negative actual torque=True; reverse activations=1; rear collision callbacks=121

checks.name: runtime pause clears visual effects
checks.detail: Time.timeScale=0; game delta 0.0000s, real 0.40s; phase PAUSED_CLEAR

checks.name: held pedal after pause does not retrigger
checks.detail: Continuous stopped pedal release for one cooldown, or actual departure followed by stopped cooldown, required before another activation.

checks.name: sequential ignition pattern and vent timing
checks.detail: First pattern age 0.204s; first vent age 0.602s; frame tolerance 0.085s.

checks.name: single stage start per activation
checks.detail: Pattern starts=3, vent starts=2, activation count=3. Paused activation may end before its vent stage.

checks.name: temporary fixtures and particles cleaned
checks.detail: Temporary wall colliders removed, original vehicle pose/velocity/time scale and seat component restored.

sampling: At most 60Hz during active VFX, 15Hz otherwise, plus phase changes. Contact callbacks remain continuous.
